record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose this. A panel keeps the main screen the same everywhere and needs no hidden screen state, while still putting the diagnosis first for the kinds that are about one.

## Counter-argument

Opening the Journal screen gives repair work the whole pane for its story instead of five rows squeezed above a table.

payload.alternatives: opening the Journal screen when switching to such an effort; repair opening Journal and evaluate opening the Evidence tab
payload.choice: Repair and evaluate efforts show a Journal panel of open items above the task table; deliver and incidental efforts are unchanged
